current_verified_evidence.mounted_dmg_verification: A read-only mount passed manifest verification, forbidden-secret scan, universal-binary checks, the exact Team ID designated requirement, hardened runtime, Developer ID signature, Gatekeeper assessment, validation of the contained app's stapled notarization ticket, and DMG Applications-symlink verification. The Applications alias points to /Applications. Finder installed these exact app bytes into /Applications and Gatekeeper accepted first launch on the build Mac. The DMG container itself is not claimed to carry a separate stapled ticket. Independent clean-Mac acceptance remains unverified.

physical_iphone_acceptance.acceptance_summary: A fresh Codex gpt-5.6-sol birth passed the one bounded repair, deterministic build and Simulator gates, signed physical-device build, install, and launch. The native Mac app was terminated while work was active and reopened from Finder; the service and execution continued. Version 1 reports installed on the physical iPhone, and independent local inspection verifies its intention bytes, embedded metadata, selected records, and contiguous lineage.
physical_iphone_acceptance.device_delivery_blocker: The paired iPhone disconnected after Version 1 installed. All three prepared deliveries are preserved and wait for cable reconnection and unlock; none is recorded as accepted.

blocking_reason: The exact ADR 0029 candidate is Developer ID signed, accepted by Apple notarization submission d95ff96d-a536-4777-814d-8c43ae4f7ecd, stapled, packaged, locally verified, installed through Finder, accepted by Gatekeeper on the build Mac, and has completed one fresh physical-iPhone birth with source and lineage verification. A same-app evolution and two additional fresh apps completed their implementation, bounded-repair where needed, and deterministic gates, but all three are waiting for physical-device delivery because the iPhone disconnected. The protected v1.0.2 tag remains unpublished. Publication remains blocked on independent clean-Mac/user acceptance; completion of those waiting device deliveries and the three-fresh-app criterion; a least-privilege Bankr LLM Gateway key, model allowlist, funded staging use, backup/restore drill, and real managed grant/checkout/duplicate/inference/cap/refund/dispute/failure/reconciliation tests; immutable artifact publication; independent downloaded-digest and public-manifest verification; public installer activation; and post-activation health verification. The obsolete npm-first product decision is superseded by ADR 0025 and is not treated as authority to bypass these current native gates. Owner publication intent is recorded but does not waive them.
